I need to get bread, get to the grocery, stock it, and start earning or this day is a loss.  Marta's talking, which means she's engaged.  I wait for her response now - Ainsley hearing this negotiation means the cafe owner knows my business, which might be useful later or might mean Ainsley will try to undercut me.  Either way, I need numbers from Marta and then I move.

The household bill is 450 today and I only have 691.  After I stock, I need to make sales or I'm short. 681 sim. Time to stop wandering and start selling. </think>   Marta's still here. Good. No prices posted, so I need her to deal direct. I need to stop performing for an audience and just get goods.

Better strategy: if Marta won't deal direct, I'll go to the mill and get flour from my mother. Not ideal - flour needs processing, customers want finished goods. But it's something.

Actually - I just realized. The mill might have milled products ready. Let me think about what the mill produces... the recipes list says mill does: barley->malt, corn->cornmeal, cotton->thread, rice->milled rice, soybean->tofu, wheat->flour. Some of those are grocery items. Tofu, flour, cornmeal, malt...

But I still need vegetables. And I still need to price everything and stock it.

I'm going to give Marta one more chance to name a price, then I'm walking. To the mill if I have to. </think>   I wait for her number. Fifteen seconds, Marta, or I'm gone. The morning's burning and I've customers coming.
